content.title: CenterPoint unveils $65 billion capital spending plan over next 10 years
content.summary: Data centers dedicated to artificial intelligence and cryptocurrency, as well as the electrification of industries such as transportation, are driving up U.S. power consumption.  CenterPoint also raised its annual adjusted earnings per share forecast to between $1.75 and $1.77 per share, from $1.74 to $1.76 per share earlier.  The U.S. electric and gas utility also expects 2026 adjusted EPS targeting at least the midpoint of the range of $1.89 to $1.91 per share.
